evidence_slice: The Hartlepool Development Corporation (Establishment) Order 2023 (UKSI 2023/104), made 30 January 2023 and in force from 27 February 2023, establishes the Hartlepool Development Corporation. Article 2 defines the Mayoral development area as the areas of land shown bounded externally by the inside edge of the black lines on two official maps. The explanatory memorandum states that the corporation covers Hartlepool town centre and is intended to provide strategic leadership for economic development and regeneration.
